newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 10-THURSDAY SEPTEMBER 19.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 10-THURSDAY SEPTEMBER 19.

text.p: - Reuter European Court of Justice Diary - Opinion C-139/95 Livia Belestra v/ Istituto nazionale per la previdenza social (INPS) - social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 1 and 5 of Council directive 79/7/EEC of December 19, 1978, on the progressive implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women in social security matters and of articles 1, 2 and 5 of Council directive 76/207/EEC of February 9, 1976, on the implementation of the principal of equal treatment for men and women as regards access to jobs, job training and promotion and working conditions. Special policy in favour of workers in companies declared "in crisis" that, in accordance with the possibilities of early retirement and interest on fictive payment periods, apply a different retirement age to male and female workers, taking into account that the general scheme allows women to retire at 55 without attaining the normal retirement age of 60. - (1530/1330 GMT) Oral procedure C-325/95 Phytheron International SA v/ Jean Bourdon SA - free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 30 and 36 of the EC treaty. Parallel imports of an authorised phytosanitary product of extra-Community origin protected by an identical brand name in the two member states in question.
(All venues Luxembourg, Plateau de Kirchberg)
TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 10

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-61/94 Commission v/ Germany: external relations. Non-respect. EC treaty Article 228, paragraph 7 and Council decision 80/271 of December 10, 1979, regarding the conclusion of multilateral agreements resulting from 1973-1979 trade negotiations. Non-application within the framework of active improvement of international arrangements concerning milk products concluded under GATT. - Judgment C-222/94 Commission v/ United Kingdom: free movement of persons. Non-respect. Failure to have correctly transposed Council directive 89/552/EEC of October 3, 1989, intended to co-ordinate certain legal, regulatory and administrative provisions concerning televised radio broadcasting activities. - Judgment C-277/94 Z. Taflan-Met and others v/ Bestuur van de Sociale Verzekeringsbank: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of decision 3/80 of the EEC/Turkey Association Council on social security arrangements of member states concerning Turkish workers and their families. Direct effect of articles 12 and 13 on invalidity payments and old-age and death pensions. - Judgment C-11/95 Commission v/ Belgium: free movement of persons. Non-respect. Articles 2, 14 and 15 of Council directive 89/552/EEC of October 3, 1989, on the co-ordination of certain legal, regulatory and administrative provisions concerning televised radio broadcasting activities. Cable re-transmissions from other member states. Ban on advertisements for medical treatments and alcoholic beverages. - Oral procedure C-24/95 Land Rheinland-Pfalz v/ Alcan Deutschland GmbH: state aid. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Community law concerning state aid. Articles 92 and 93, paragraph 3 of EC treaty. Obligation to recover illegal aid. Difficulties arising from national rules protecting aid beneficiaries. - (1100/0900 GMT) Oral procedure C-59/95 Francisco Bastos Moriana and others v/ Bundesanstalt fuer Arbeit: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 77, paragraph 2(b) and 78 paragraph 2(b), 79, paragraph 1 and 94, paragraph 5 of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. Payments for children entitled to pensions or annuities due under the legislation of several member states. Right to a complement when the payments of the state of residence are under those provided for by the laws of one of the other states involved. - (1530/1330 GMT) Oral procedure C-169/95 Spain v/ Commission: state aid. Annulment of Commission decision of March 14, 1995, on investment aids granted by the Spanish government to Piezas y Rhodajes SA. Aid answering the conditions of a regional aid system previously approved by the Commission. Obligation to repay an aid approved by the Commission at a previous stage.
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 11

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, SECOND CHAMBER (enlarged)(0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure T-227/95 AssiDoman Kraft Products and others v/ Commission: competition. Annulment of Commission decision in letter of October 4, 1995, refusing to repay fines imposed on the claimant by a decision in respect of a breach of article 85 of the EC treaty partially annulled by the Court judgment of March 31, 1993, in case C-89/85.
THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 12

COURT OF JUSTICE, FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment joined cases C-58/95 Gallotti, C-75/95 Censi, C-112/95 Salmaggi, C-119/95 Pasquire, C-123/95 Zappone, C-135/95 Segna, C-140/95 Cervetti, C-141/95 Gasbarri, C-154/95 Narducci, C-157/95 Smaldone: environment and consumers. Request for preliminary ruling. Compatibility of a national law with Council directive 91/156/EEC of March 18, 1991, modifying directive 75/442/EEC of July 15, 1975, on waste. - Oral procedure C-241/95 The Queen, ex parte: Accrington Beef Co. v/ Intervention Board for Agricultural Produce: commercial policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 1, paragraph 2 and 2, paragraph 2 of Commission regulation 214/94 of January 31, 1994, amending the application of Council regulation 130/94 regarding import policy on frozen bovine meat as it pertains to code NC 0202 and of products referred to under code NC 0206 29 91. Tariff contingent. Eligibility conditions for new operators. Minimum quantity of bovine meat exported to third countries during the preceding year. Increase in respect to preceding regulation. Possibility in case of company merger to accumulate rights to tariff contingent. Exclusion of new operators.

THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure C-255/95 S. Agri and others v/ Regione Veneto: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 1, paragraph 3(c) of Council regulation 797/85 of March 12, 1985, on improving the efficiency of agricultural structures. Aids intended to extend the production of bovine meat. Conditions of grant. - (1030/0830 GMT) Oral procedure C-273/95 Impresa Agricola Buratti Leonardo, Pierluigi e Livio v/ Tabacchicoltori Associati Veneti Soc. coop. (TAV): agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 8 and 10 to 12 of Commission regulation 3478/92 of December 1, 1992, on the premium system in the raw tobacco sector. Conditions on the granting of premiums on leaf tobacco. Date of delivery. Producers co-operative or processing companies.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-251/94 Eduardo Lafuente Nieto v/ Instituto Nacionall de la Seguridad Social (INSS) and Tesoreria General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS): free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 46, paragraph 2(c) and 47, paragraph 2(b) and (e) of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1982, and articles 48 and 51 of the EC treaty. Validity of article 47, paragraph 2(e), introduced by the 1985 membership act. Invalidity insurance. Estimation of payments. Spanish law subjecting the right to payments to a minimum affiliation period of at least 84 months. - Judgment joined cases C-254/94, C-255/94, C-269/94 Fattoria autonoma tabacchi and others v/ Ministers dell'Agricoltura et delle Foreste and others: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of articles 3, paragraph 3, 9 and 10 of Commission regulation 3477/92 of December 1, 1992. Raw tobacco. Quota allocation. Compatibility with the principles of Council regulation 2075/92 of June 30, 1992. Possibility for a member state to create reserves according to variety and divided among operations according to the provisions set out in a ministerial notice. Ban on giving a producers association a certificate for a single species or a single production quota. - Judgment C-278/94 Commission v/ Belgium: free movement of persons. Non-respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 89/665/EEC of December 21, 1989, on the co-ordination of laws, regulations and administrative provisions as they apply to appeal procedures for public procurement supply contracts. - Opinion C-340/94 E.J.M. de Jaeck c/ Staatssecretaris van Finanacien: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 14 and 14C of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. Notion of "salaried activity". Activity exercised as director of a company in which the individual is the sole share holder. Salaried worker employed in one member state and exercising simultaneously a non-salaried activity in another member state of residence. - Opinion joined cases C-88/95, C-102/95 and C-103/95 Bernardina Martinez Losada and others v/ Instituto Nacional de Empleo (INEM), Instituto Nacional de la Segurida Social (INSS): free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 48, paragraph 2, and 51 of the EC treaty and of article 67, paragraph 1 of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. National law on unemployment benefit to salaried workers that includes a non-contributor's payment, intended for unemployed workers above a certain age, to those having the right to a pension in the national old age pension scheme.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-221/94 Commission v/ Luxembourg: approximation of legislation. Non-respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 91/263/EEC of April 19, 1991, on the approximation of member states' legislation on telecommunications terminals, including mutual recognition of their authorisation. - Opinion C-142/95-P ASsociazione agricoltori della provincia di Rovigo and others v/ Commission, Mauro Girello and Greguoldo Daniele: environment and consumers. Appeal against the Court order (fourth chamber) rendered February 21, 1995, in case T-117/94 - Associazione agricoltori della provincia di Rovigo and others v/ Commission. Admissibility of an appeal for annulment introduced by a physical or moral person against a decision not pronounced at his intention. Decision to grant a co-financing of the basis of Commission regulation 1793/92 of July 1, 1992, for actions for the protection of the habitat and nature in the park of the Po delta. Right of farmers and farmers' associations to be consulted. - Opinion C-262/95 Commission v/ Germany: environment and consumers. Non-respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directives 82/176/EEC of March 22, 1982, on limit values and quality objectives for mercury discharges by the chlor-alkali electrolysis industry, 83/512/EEC of September 26, 1983 on limit values and quality objectives for cadmium discharges, 84/156/EEC on limit values and quality objectives for mercury discharges by industries other than the chlor-alkali electrolysis industry, 84/491/EEC of October 9, 1984, on limit values and quality objectives for discharges of hexachlorocyclohexane, 86/280/EEC of June 12, 1986, on limit values and quality objectives for discharges of certain dangerous substances included in List I of the Annex to Directive 76/464/EEC. Fixation of limit values by administrative procedures without any constraints on individuals. - Opinion C-314/95 Commission v/ Italy: agriculture. Non-respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directives 92/45/EEC of June 16, 1992, on sanitary problems and policies in respect to the killing of wild game and the marketing of wild game, 92/46/EEC of June 16, 1992, fixing sanitary rules on the production and marketing of raw milk, heat-treated milk and milk-based products, 92/65/EEC of July 13, 1992, defining Community sanitary policy covering the trade and import of animals, sperm, eggs and embryos not subject, in respect of sanitary policy, to the specific Community regulations addressed in annex A, section I of directive 90/425/EEC, 92/B8/EEC of October 26, 1992, amending and updating directive 71/188/EEC on sanitary problems in respect of exchanges of fresh meat and poultry, 92/117/EEC of December 17, 1992, on protection measures against specified zoonoses and specified zoonotic agents in animals and products of animal origin in order to prevent outbreaks of food-borne infections and intoxication, 92/118/EEC of December 17, 1992, laying down animal health and public health requirements governing trade in and imports into the Community of products not subject to the said requirements laid down in specific Community rules referred to in Annex A (I) of directive 89/662/EEC and, as regards pathogens, to directive 90/425/EEC. - Oral procedure C-69/95 Italy v/ Commission: agriculture. Partial annulment of the decision on the clearance of the accounts presented by Member States in respect of expenditure for 1990 of the EAGGF, Guarantee Section. Expenditure for the acquisition of milk quotas in order to redistribute them to other producers.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure joined cases T-454/93, T-455/93, T-456/93 and T-457/93 Elders Trading Ltd and Paterson Elders (Produce) Ltd and others v/ Commission: agriculture. Annulment of article 2 of Commission regulation 1922/92 of July 13, 1992, amending regulation 1633/84 of June 8, 1984, laying down detailed rules for applying the variable slaughter premium for sheep and repealing regulation 2661/80 and determining conditions for the reimbursement of the clawback following the judgment of the Court of Justice in joined cases C-38/990 and C/151/90.
PROVISIONAL AGENDA FOR TUESDAY-THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 17-19
TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 17

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-28/95 A. Leur-Bloem v/ Inspecteur der Belastingdienst/Ondernemingen Amsterdam 2: taxation. - Opinion C-130/95 Bernd Giloy v/ Hauptzollamt Frankfurt am Main-Ost. Case related to C-28/95: free movement of goods. - Opinion joined cases C-34/95, C-35/95 and C-36/95 Konsumentombudsmannen (KO) v/ De Agostini (Svenska) Foerlag AB and others: free movement of persons.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment joined cased C-246/94, C-247/94, C-248/94 and C-249/94 Cooperativa Agricola Zootecnica S. Antonio and others v/ Amministrazione delle Finanze dello Stato and others: free movement of goods. - Judgment C-289/94 Commission v/ Italy: approximation of legislation.
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 18
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure T-149/94, T-181/94 Kernkraftwerke. I Lippe-Ems v/ Commission: procurement.

FOURTH CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment T-155/94 Climax Paper Converters v/ Council: commercial policy. - Judgment T-387/94 ASia Motor France and others v/ Commission: competition. - Oral procedure T-105/95 WWF UK v/ Commission: institutional law.
THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 19

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-42/95 Siemens AG v/ Henry Nold: company law - Opinion C-66/95 The Queen, ex parte Eunice Sutton v/ Secretary of State for Social Security: social policy.
FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-38/95 Ministero delle Finanze v/ Foods Import Srl: free movement of goods.
FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-153/95 ANDRE en Co, NV v/ Belgische Staat: agriculture.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-96/95 Commission v/ Germany: free movement of persons. - Opinion C-166/95-P Commission v/ Frederic Daffis: statute of officials. - Opinion C-178/95 Wiljo NV v/ Belgische Staat: transport. - Opinion C-290/95 Commission v/ Italy: environment and consumers.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure T-115/94 Opel Austria (formerly General Motors Austria) v/ Council: external relations.
